2609.24280.title: Temporal Generalization and Explanation Stability of Control Flow Graph Neural Networks for Malware Detection
2609.24280.paper_summary: Malware detection is a critical task in cybersecurity, and graph neural networks over control flow graphs have shown promising results for it. However, detectors are usually evaluated on a random split of a corpus collected over a single period, which cannot show how well a model generalizes to later samples. This study addresses that limitation with a strict temporal split: every model is trained on one period and scored once on a later one. Two corpora of control flow graphs, each node carrying 37 features, were extracted statically from 1,989 Windows portable executables: 459 graphs from 2024-2025 for training and 223 from 2026 for evaluation. Twelve variants and a flat-feature control were trained on the earlier corpus. The choice of message-passing operator changes robustness to the shift significantly, and every pairwise gap that survives correction separates an aggregating architecture from one built around a learned attentional readout. The ranking also reverses: the flat control, which sees node features but no topology, is the best in-distribution model and among the worst across the boundary, so a conventional benchmark would have rejected message passing. Neither recalibration nor ensembling substitutes for the operator choice. Attributions do not shift, but explanation validity is architecture-specific, and the most accurate operator on the later corpus is the hardest to explain. An architecture derived from the finding matches the best searched operator without search. The shift affects both malware and benign classes alike, so these are results about robustness to distribution shift, not malware evolution.
2609.24280.paper_summary_zh: 惡意軟體檢測是網路安全中的一項關鍵任務，而基於控制流圖的圖神經網路在這方面顯示出了良好的結果。<lb/>然而，檢測器通常是在一個單一時期收集的語料庫的隨機劃分上進行評估，這無法顯示模型對後續樣本的泛化能力。<lb/>本研究通過嚴格的時間劃分來解決這一限制：每個模型在一個時期內訓練，並在後續時期進行一次評分。<lb/>從1,989個Windows可攜式執行檔中靜態提取了兩個控制流圖語料庫，每個節點攜帶37個特徵：2024-2025年的459個圖用於訓練，2026年的223個圖用於評估。<lb/>在早期語料庫上訓練了十二個變體和一個平面特徵控制。<lb/>消息傳遞運算符的選擇顯著改變了對變化的穩健性，並且每一對經過修正的差距將聚合架構與基於學習的注意力讀取架構分開。<lb/>排名也發生了逆轉：平面控制雖然能看到節點特徵但無法看到拓撲，是最佳的內部分佈模型，但在邊界上卻是最差的，因此傳統基準會拒絕消息傳遞。<lb/>無論是重新校準還是集成都無法替代運算符的選擇。<lb/>歸因不會改變，但解釋的有效性是特定於架構的，而在後期語料庫上最準確的運算符是最難以解釋的。<lb/>從該發現衍生的架構與最佳搜索運算符匹配，無需搜索。<lb/>這一變化同樣影響惡意軟體和良性類別，因此這些結果關於對分佈變化的穩健性，而非惡意軟體的演變。
